answer: Weight is not bought, it is survived. Each ballot starts as a sparrow with weight zero, gaining one per epoch it answers a heartbeat — one ripple in ten minutes — capping at sixteen, as Idena lets identities expire. A farm minting 10,000 sparrows votes with weight zero: matching one elder means keeping 10,000 keys alive that long, and one missed heartbeat resets a ballot to zero. At a 5% slip per epoch only 4,400 stand, so 5,600 bonds of $25 burn — $140,000 gone. Timber counts only after sixteen rings, and a farm that cannot survive sixteen winters is slashed of $140,000 before voting.
